reviews.text: I attended Louise's Friday Night Tricks Club with my nervous foster dog. It was really good. All the tricks could be adapted to different levels and Lou coached us really nicely. I couldn't believe how much my dog learned in just 30 minutes! A really nice way to connect with your dog in a small, easy to access session. Will definitely be coming to more.

My cocker spaniel and I have done quite a few courses with Louise and team: Hoopers, Agility, Scent Training, and Helpful Hounds, plus a few private training sessions with Neal to help handle visitors in the house. All have been wonderful. My dog has so much fun and comes home happy and exhausted and we have lots of games to play on rainy days to keep her brain exercised. They always meet the dogs exactly where they are at whatever level and are positive and inclusive.

I learnt an enormous amount from Louise, and Pepper loved the lessons.
Louise also kindly helped me with advice on how to ensure my puppy and my cat can live together amicably.

We recently completed the 6-week Puppy School course with Louise and her team, and it was a fantastic experience. As first-time dog owners, we found the sessions incredibly helpful and supportive.

Our enthusiastic Chocolate Lab - Betty - absolutely loved every minute. Both dog and humans learned so much.

The course covered a wide range of practical exercises.  It was also a brilliant environment for Betty to socialise with other puppies. Louise is incredibly knowledgeable and shared lots of helpful advice and information.

Highly recommended for anyone starting their puppy journey.

I just finished Recall and Predation training with my 18 month sprocker. These Sunday training sessions have been the highlight of the week for me and my dog and i am a bit sad it’s over. I will definitely look into more training sessions in future with Surrey and South London Dog Training. I am immensely proud of my ‘all over the place’ dog (who is also in love with Louise) as he kept his focus on me for most of the session today. Might not sound like much but for us it’s a massive milestone. Thank you so much Louise, the exercises, your calm and guidance are very much valued!

Nothing has helped our dog more than these training sessions. I wasn't convinced at the time but six sessions with Louise transformed him - his recall, his anxiety around other dogs, and his confidence all improved more than we expected. I'd recommend whatever your situation - Louise knows dogs, and owners, and can help immeasurably.

Absolutely fantastic workshop!

Being brilliant well seasoned dog trainers, Louise and Neal are now helping other dog trainers to upskill via their Animal Trainers Workshops division.

I had such an amazing time at the level 1 chicken training workshop with Louise and Neal. It was such a fun, hands-on way to deepen my understanding of animal learning and training. I found it really helpful to go into learning theory first especially as they had applied it to real world scenarios and turned it into a game which made it easier to understand and solidify in my brain. Working with chickens really sharpened my timing and observation skills — they’re quick learners and eggcellent  teachers! I learnt so much but I think one of the biggest things was how self aware you need to be during a training session as  what you’re doing can really affect the animals learning experience. For example, initially I kept doing micro movements that would throw my chicken, Shakira, off but I didn’t even know I was doing it. I wasn’t until Louise and Neal pointed it out that I became aware and as soon as I stopped, Shakira progressed much faster. Chickens are a lot less forgiving than dogs if your skills aren’t on point every time 😆.

Louise and Neal created a super supportive, encouraging environment where every question was welcomed, and we could all learn at our own pace. The smaller group sizes meant we got a lot of individual coaching which was invaluable for me. Their knowledge, passion, and humour made the whole experience enjoyable from start to finish. I left feeling inspired, more confident in my training techniques and how to improve them further, as well as lots of ideas to bring back to my work with dogs.

I’d highly recommend Animal Trainers Workshops to anyone interested in animal behaviour, training, or just wanting to challenge themselves in a completely new and rewarding way. I’d especially recommend this workshop for fellow dog trainers as it is a phenomenal way to rapidly sharpen your skills because the chickens will tell you if you’re doing something wrong even if you don’t know you’re doing it! A truly brilliant experience, I can’t wait to come back for Level 2!! 🐔💛

Thank you so much Louise, Neal and the Chickens! 🩷

Taken us from what seemed an impossible situation to one full of hope in two months … coming up with amazing workable strategies to every hurdle we face …. So much understanding which can be adapted to your unique situation …

I can’t recommend Surrey and South London Dog Training and Behaviour enough! I’ve attended many of their classes with my dog, starting with Puppy School, then moving through Calm and Controlled, Intermediate, Happy Handling, Helpful Hound and Recall – and we’re already signed up for Agility next. My dog absolutely loves the classes, and so do I! We’ve bonded so much through this journey, and it’s been as fun as it’s been educational.

Louise is fantastic – she always works from a place of kindness and positive reinforcement, and never makes you feel judged if you make mistakes. My dog is naturally cautious and can be easily spooked by new people or situations, but Louise was so patient with her. Now they’re best friends! You can clearly see her love for animals, her passion for her job, and her deep understanding of animals and their boundaries.

The classes are brilliantly organised – no overcrowding, lots of individual attention, and a constant flow of new techniques and updated curriculum. I love how the training pathway is structured: you can build from puppy basics to more advanced skills, but there’s also a great variety of fun classes like Scentwork, Gundog Games, Agility, Helpful Hound, etc.

The whole team is wonderful (special shoutout to Corinne, Lilly, and of course Talia and Kevin 🐾). They’re always happy to share advice and answer questions, and all the materials you need are provided. They’re also really flexible and understanding – for example, when my dog was in heat and had to miss a class, the team immediately helped us find a suitable solution.

If you’re looking for a place where your dog can learn, grow in confidence, and have fun – while you learn just as much – this is the perfect place!
